item.title: Buying fruit at the bazaar
item.context_text: Your friend Sara from Australia is visiting Tashkent. You take her to Chorsu Bazaar. She wants to buy fruit, and she asks you for help in English.
item.objective_text: Read the prices, understand what Sara wants, and tell her the total price.
item.target_grammar: How much is / are…? and numbers with thousand
item.cultural_note: At an Uzbek bazaar, sellers often let you taste the fruit before you buy. Prices are usually for one kilo.
success_conditions: Read and compare the prices on the stall
Understand what Sara wants to buy

children.title: Read the price list
children.instructions: Read the price list on the fruit stall. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
Today's prices (for 1 kilo)
Apples — 12,000 som
Grapes — 18,000 som
Pomegranates — 25,000 som
Dried apricots — 60,000 som
Buy 3 kilos of apples, pay for 2!

questions.explanation: Dried apricots are 60,000 som a kilo, the highest price.

questions.prompt: You buy 3 kilos of apples. How much do you pay?
questions.explanation: "Buy 3 kilos of apples, pay for 2": 2 × 12,000 = 24,000 som.

children.title: Listen to Sara
children.instructions: Listen to Sara. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Wow, this bazaar is so big! I want some fruit for my hotel room. I love grapes, but I don't like apples. Can you ask for one kilo of grapes and half a kilo of dried apricots, please?

questions.prompt: How many grapes does she want?
questions.explanation: She asks for "one kilo of grapes".

questions.prompt: How much does Sara's fruit cost?
questions.explanation: One kilo of grapes is 18,000 som and half a kilo of dried apricots is 30,000 som: 48,000 som.

children.title: Tell Sara the price
children.instructions: Sara asks you a question. Answer out loud. Tell her the total price for her fruit.
children.prompt_text: Sara: So how much do I pay?
children.model_answer: It is forty-eight thousand som. The grapes are eighteen thousand and the apricots are thirty thousand.
